'''Kwātī''' ({{langx|new|क्वाती}} (where {{Lang|new|क्वा}} (kwā) = 'hot' and {{Lang|new|ती}} (tī) = 'soup'); {{langx|ne|क्वाँटी}}) is a mixed soup of nine types of sprouted beans. It is a traditional Newari dish consumed on the festival of Guni Punhi, the full moon day of [[Gunla|Gunlā]] which is the tenth month in the [[Nepal Era]] [[lunar calendar]].
